dedupe_keys.name: rivne nuclear power plant cooling water chemistry and scaling indices

description: This collection contains physicochemical measurements used to assess scaling and corrosion in the cooling-water supply system of Rivne nuclear power plant, Ukraine. The water-engineering research team measures pH, temperature and total dissolved solids on site, with laboratory analyses of chloride, sulphate, calcium and alkalinity. The article describes three samples per day during 2022–2023 and calculated indicators of corrosive or scale-forming potential. Mendeley publishes one Excel XLS workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one cooling-water system, and the indicators describe water chemistry, not observed probabilities of pipe or reactor failure. Laboratory methods and operating conditions limit transfer to other installations. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating water-quality assumptions or maintenance scenarios for coupled electricity and cooling-water simulations. model-epanet is a related water-network tool, although its standard reactions do not directly reproduce every reported corrosion index. No workbook, chemical calculation or hydraulic model was executed.
